name: paper-classroom-v1
purpose: Vietnamese educational motion slides inspired by the supplied local reference
rules: Portrait 4:5 white teaching canvas; no dark dashboard chrome.
Keep an original compact lesson header and a yellow checklist at the upper right.
Thin blue and green bordered tables with clearly labeled column headers.
Show the relevant operation progressively; use curved arrows and colored row highlights.
Display a short highlighted takeaway above the narration strip.
Narration strip resembles taped paper and uses the approved Vietnamese script.
Drive important visual beats from narration cue timestamps where possible.
Use generous whitespace but avoid long blank waits or unreadably small tables.
Do not copy the reference creator's logo, character artwork, or brand identity.
Retain original script, reference inspection, captions, source audio, renders and QA.
This is a reusable rendering profile, not model-weight training.
